DateWire.description: ISO 8601 calendar date encoded as a `YYYY-MM-DD` JSON string.

anyOf.description: A JSON number in the domain of the selected numeric representation.

FiniteOrNanWireFordouble.description:
A finite numeric representation or the undefined-result sentinel `"nan"`.

Use `f64` for an unrestricted JSON number, or a validated numeric wire type
such as [`super::ClosedUnitIntervalF64Wire`] to retain its range constraints.
Unlike [`NonFiniteF64Wire`], its JSON contract excludes infinity sentinel strings.

alphas.description: Annual arithmetic Jensen alpha; undefined windows serialize as `"nan"`.

betas.description: Dimensionless OLS beta; unavailability matches alpha at every date.

dates.description: Strictly increasing return-ending dates, one per completed window.
